description: This file contains utility functions for weekly calendar views, including date calculations, grid cell to datetime conversions, merging overlapping date ranges, and calculating hour sizes in pixels.

methods.name: weekdayDates
methods.description: Calculates start and end dates of a week given a start day and length.

methods.name: gridCellToDateTime
methods.description: Converts grid cell index to a specific datetime within a day, considering timezone and start hour.

methods.name: getDaysBetweenDates
methods.description: Returns an array of dayjs dates between two dates, limited to 7 days.

methods.name: getHoursToDisplay
methods.description: Generates an array of dayjs objects representing each hour between startHour and endHour in a given timezone.

methods.name: mergeOverlappingDateRanges
methods.description: Merges overlapping date ranges into a consolidated list.

methods.name: calculateHourSizeInPx
methods.description: Calculates pixel height per hour for calendar display based on container size and time range.
